note_sections.t: Ongoing monitoring of elevated prostate-specific antigen levels subsequent to a previously positive biopsy.

He maintains a non-smoker status and shares his home with a partner, appreciating the adaptable nature of his self-employed design work. His coronary artery disease is managed with atorvastatin and metoprolol, and his most recent cardiology assessment noted stable angina with well-regulated lipid levels. He adheres to a daily 45-minute walking regimen while consuming alcohol in moderation. Lower urinary tract symptoms remain mild (IPSS 7/35), and a recent orthopaedic visit addressed a longstanding knee issue that continues to avoid surgical management. He has never married, listing his brother as his primary emergency contact.

DRE reveals a prostate of uniform consistency and symmetry, devoid of nodular irregularities or focal asymmetry, consistent with a normal digital rectal examination. Vital signs remain stable throughout the general assessment, which shows no peripheral lymphadenopathy or abdominal masses.
